line_items.reasoning: Guidance called for Q3 revenues down low double digits (~10%+), but actual results came in at -9% reported / -7% currency-neutral, which is meaningfully better than the guided low double-digit decline.
Gross margins declined 330 bps to 41.5%, landing squarely within the guided range of ~300–350 bps contraction.

Guidance called for SG&A slightly down YoY, but demand creation expenses grew high single digits (~8%) YoY, driving total SG&A higher than guided — though this was partly an intentional strategic investment.
No explicit reported figure contradicts the $30M–$40M guidance range, so results are treated as roughly in line with prior guidance.
